module.name: no-floating-promises
module.description: Require handling of explicit, local async, and type-resolved promises.

scenarios.name: should allow an awaited promise
scenarios.given: an async function that awaits a promise-returning call

scenarios.name: should allow a promise with a .catch() rejection handler
should allow a promise prefixed with void
should report a promise call whose result is not awaited or handled
scenarios.given: a statement that calls an async function without await, void, or .catch

scenarios.name: should report a promise returned from a then() callback without handling
scenarios.given: a .then() callback that returns a new unhandled promise

scenarios.name: should report stable local async declarations and expressions
scenarios.given: an async function declaration or initialized async arrow/function is called without handling
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: a noFloatingPromises diagnostic is reported even if the declaration follows the call

scenarios.name: should respect lexical shadowing and overwritten functions
scenarios.given: a synchronous parameter or local variable shadows an async function, or its binding is overwritten
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the name alone does not produce a false async diagnostic

scenarios.name: should keep async binding analysis isolated between files
scenarios.given: an async run function in one file is followed by a synchronous or unresolved run in another
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: only the first file is reported

scenarios.name: should distinguish async generators from promise producers
scenarios.given: an async generator declaration or immediate generator invocation returns an iterator
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: no floating promise diagnostic is reported

scenarios.name: should recognize promises through optional TypeScript services
scenarios.given: a typed external call or value has a callable then property, including a union with a promise member
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the floating result is reported; synchronous values and noncallable then properties are allowed

scenarios.name: should require a terminal rejection handler
scenarios.given: a catch is followed by then or finally without another catch
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the newly produced promise is reported instead of accepting an earlier handler

scenarios.name: should reject absent or visibly unsafe rejection callbacks
scenarios.given: a terminal callback is missing, null, undefined, async, or visibly throws or returns Promise.reject
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the expression is reported instead of treating the argument count as proof of handling

scenarios.name: should allow deliberate promise handling
scenarios.given: the expression is awaited, returned, explicitly voided or has a usable terminal callback
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
